Hannah Arendt on responsibility

Hannah Arendt (1906–1975) approaches responsibility within political theory. She distinguished labor, work, and action, and argued that political freedom arises in shared speech and initiative. Systematically, the teaching links totalitarianism, action, judgment into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets responsibility most directly—useful for searches such as “hannah arendt quotes on responsibility.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Hannah Arendt thinker page for biography and to the responsibility theme for other voices on the same question.
